title: Glutathione 2% Brightening Serum

seo.title: Glutathione Serum 2% with Vitamin C | Skingenetix
seo.description: Glutathione brightening serum with stable vitamin C and niacinamide, for brighter-looking skin. The active has a placebo-controlled trial behind it.

description_html:
A brightening antioxidant serum with 2% Glutathione for a brighter-looking complexion.

  • 2% Glutathione (GSSG) - the body's master antioxidant
  • For brighter-looking skin, with a placebo-controlled trial behind the active
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: dull-looking skin that wants a brighter-looking tone and a healthy glow.

Size: 30ml
custom.key_benefits:
- Brightens - for a brighter-looking complexion, shown in a placebo-controlled trial of the active
- Softer-looking crow's feet - a secondary result of the same trial, alongside measurably smoother skin texture
- Antioxidant defence - helps neutralise the free radicals that dull skin
- Boosted with Vitamin C & Niacinamide - for extra radiance support
What to expect: in the trial of the active, the change was measurable from week 1 and visible to 1 in 4 women by week 4; give it the full 10 weeks (daily SPF essential).
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and evening. After cleansing, press 3-4 drops onto clean skin across the face and neck, before your moisturiser. Pat in gently and let it absorb for about a minute.
Daily broad-spectrum SPF is essential when using a brightening serum - it protects your results and helps keep your tone even.
Complete the routine: follow with a moisturiser such as the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Day Gel-Cream, and always SPF in the morning.
custom.clinical_research:
Topical glutathione is a brightening active with a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial behind it.
The Glutathione Brightening Serum is built around glutathione, with a stable form of vitamin C and niacinamide. In that trial:
- 2% oxidised glutathione (GSSG) gave brighter-looking skin than placebo over 10 weeks, measured by instrument and rated by the women themselves (p < 0.001)
- Measurable from week 1, and visible to 1 in 4 women by week 4
- Softer-looking crow's feet and measurably smoother skin texture as secondary results
- Well tolerated: all 30 women completed 10 weeks of twice-daily use, with no reactions attributed to glutathione
Watanabe et al. 2014, Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol: 30 women, split-face, 2% GSSG lotion, run by the GSSG manufacturer (Kyowa Hakko Bio). The results describe the ingredient as studied, not this product; the full figures are on the research page.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Glutathione 2% Brightening Serum do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A brightening serum with 2% glutathione, stable vitamin C, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It is made for a brighter-looking complexion; the active has a placebo-controlled trial behind it.

custom.faq_items.question: What is glutathione in skincare?
custom.faq_items.answer: Glutathione is an antioxidant used in cosmetics for a brighter-looking complexion; in its one controlled topical trial it brightened skin over 10 weeks. This serum contains 2% glutathione, or 20,000 ppm.

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Use morning and/or evening on clean skin, 3-4 drops to face and neck. In the morning, always follow with SPF 30+, which helps your even-tone results show.

custom.faq_items.question: How soon will I see results?
custom.faq_items.answer: Hydration and radiance can look improved within days; a more even-looking tone builds gradually over 4-8 weeks of consistent use.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I use it with vitamin C or niacinamide?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes, it already contains both, and it layers well under moisturiser and with most routines.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply Glutathione Serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply 3-4 drops to face and neck, morning and/or evening.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Moisturise + SPF
custom.how_to_steps.description: Follow with your moisturiser. SPF 30+ every morning is essential to support your even-tone results.
